depth_history.shortcut_targeted: The guaranteed two-tier architecture makes the conflict graph bipartite, allowing maximum independent set to be computed through bipartite matching.
depth_history.edit_summary: No valid single edit can defeat both surviving solutions while preserving the stated computational task. The only decisive edit would be to remove the two-tier/bipartite guarantee and allow arbitrary conflict graphs, but that changes the problem into general maximum independent set.
